purpose: Bind the first application of Ordivon Computer Core A0-A16 to Ordivon Web publication, architecture, test, performance, and deployment constraints. The audit retained evidence-backed commitment checks, narrowed exact-count and universal-source rules, separated research from execution boundaries, removed unsupported visual quantification and generated-branch deployment, and preserved editorial judgment outside metric authority.

environment.retainedConstraints: single article source; derived TOC; at least one limitation; E3+ canonical evidence; E3+ Home proof; no superseded editorial selection; type/lint/build/browser/mobile/axe checks; exact deployment source audit
environment.narrowedConstraints: takeaway count reduced from 3-5 to at least one; canonical record localized to E3+; bundle thresholds remain advisory
environment.deletedConstraints: all-article fake modified date; duplicate validator; shared project/question/boundary status; decorative quantitative bars; hardcoded production copy markers; dirty-worktree and production-branch deployment policy
environment.architectureDisposition: Computing is a research and conformance plane outside the execution path; Host, Runtime, and World are consequence boundaries with distinct maturity from project lifecycle and Question state
environment.validation: 19 article sources; 17 editorial selections; 52 static routes; 126 desktop/mobile browser tests; serious and critical axe checks; deterministic 19 social cards; static budget with no advisories
